title: Complexity of the H-factor problem.
exact_target: Classify, for each fixed graph H and density c, the computational difficulty of finding whether a dense graph has a perfect packing by copies of H.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, supplied problems.json, record 3284 (OPG-46738), OpenGarden. Catalogue identity and source transcription; CC BY 4.0.
Open Problem Garden, Complexity of the H-factor problem.. Original problem and discussion.
J. Han and A. Treglown, The complexity of perfect matchings and packings in dense hypergraphs.

status_qualification: Interprets the question as classification by fixed H and 0<c<1; a universal hardness reading is false, and c>=1 makes the simple-graph promise empty.
